bases.name: Air Evac Lifeteam 125 – Kinder, LA
bases.method: Public aviation-directory helipad coordinate corroborated by visible pad/base infrastructure in aerial imagery and on-site reporting describing US 165 south of LA 383. Address geocodes returned only town centroids and were rejected.
bases.limitation: Approximate publicly identified helipad reference south of LA 383 beside US 165, corroborated against aerial imagery. The town-center directory point is not used.

bases.name: Air Evac Lifeteam 160 – Natchitoches, LA
bases.method: Retained operator airport-site reference; CMS and chamber addresses agree. Aerial imagery places it in the airport access area. A street-interpolated geocode about 104 meters south does not establish a better aircraft position.
bases.limitation: Approximate operator airport-site reference beside Wallenburg Drive. The precise hangar or parking pad is not established; street interpolation is not a more precise launch point.

sources.purpose: Current operator base identity and public address; directory coordinates assessed independently.
Public air-transport practice address; registration alone does not establish current aircraft availability.
Independent address geocode; locality-only and interpolated results are not accepted as precise landing points.
Publicly distributed AMCN list corroborates all four Louisiana base identifiers and rotor-wing classifications.
Local chamber corroborates the public Wallenburg/Wallenberg base address.
Current GMR Natchitoches helicopter-service recruitment corroborates operating program identity.

exclusions: Legacy Med-Trans Life Air Rescue registrations in Shreveport, Natchitoches and Winnfield and Flight Care in New Orleans are not accepted as proof of current GMR bases. They are absent from the current operator and publicly distributed AMCN base lists.
Acadian Air Med and Ochsner Flight Care are not substituted for GMR AirMed International; similar names alone do not establish GMR affiliation.

geometry.source: US Census Generalized ACS 2024, 500K county-equivalent geometry
geometry.method: WGS84 geodesic circles and county/parish-edge distance comparisons.

limitations: Approximate site references are labeled, not surveyed aircraft parking positions.
AEL 160 exact hangar/parking position is not established; its public airport-site reference is retained.
County/parish boundaries are generalized, not cadastral surveys.
Adjacent-state inventories remain incomplete during rollout; mapped overlap does not imply current availability.
